headRight.text: Twelve engines run live on the docs page under the readme, each on a plate with the call that mounts it. Every engine mounts on first view, runs on screen, pauses off screen, and renders one frame under reduced motion. The plates below are cut from the page at two times device scale. Four are cropped to the engine itself.

items.label: Horizon field
items.sub: A WebGL lens shader takes 21 parameters.

items.label: Glyph field
items.sub: Glyphs from eight scripts form one word.

items.label: Ink field
items.sub: Glyphs rise through the band margins.

items.label: Prismatic field
items.sub: A spectral wash runs behind the bands.

items.label: Dither
items.sub: A CPU Bayer pass draws one pixel per cell.

items.label: Studio field
items.sub: Ten Bayer presets share one GL context.

items.label: Iso
items.sub: A 30 degree projection draws every solid.

items.label: Doubled line
items.sub: One path is stroked twice into two threads.

items.label: Edge globe
items.sub: The globe shows five PoPs and one route.

items.label: Locale tag
items.sub: A 15 by 11 flag prints beside the code.

items.label: Reveal seam
items.sub: A slider writes one CSS variable.

items.label: Glyph reassembler
items.sub: One sentence reforms in the next locale.
